notes.title: [UPDATE] Hotfix - Patch 1.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/3d9e1914999b2dddeaafc2ec260bf27c8fca9a52.png

Hello everyone! 

Here's a hotfix to correct some of the problems introduced by patch 1.4. We've also been able to fix a few other bugs that have come to light thanks to the save files you've sent us. 


 Fixed corrupted saves following the sacrifice of vampires (which shouldn’t have been sacrifice-able in the first place). 
 Fixed a soft-lock occurring when shifting focus between windows (in/out of game) during a dialogue. 
 Fixed some cases of never-ending construction. 
 Fixed demons getting stuck when following their cultist. 
 Fixed adventurers randomly getting stuck. 
 Fixed a soft-lock occurring when a victory screen is displayed before the end of an incursion. 
 Further reduced the amount of interns ‘consumed’ by vampires. 
 Fixed loss of focus when using movement keys (e.g. WASD) while naming a save file. 
 Fixed invincible enemies (they are no longer invincible).


Thanks again for your help!

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/96ddeb4ab0f11c7f9fb75ffae8c898a7593c83a2.png

Hey everyone!

Naheulbeuk’s Dungeon Master Version 1.4 is now available! 

We'd like to thank all the players who have reported bugs and sent us their save files. This has helped us identify some of the more evasive bugs that haven’t yet been caught during our many (many) QA tests.

This patch addresses a number of issues that should no longer affect future playthroughs.

As always, do not hesitate to let us know of any issues you may encounter by reporting them  here.

We have the upcoming Winter Sale where you can buy the game with a 10% discount! Stay tuned!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2005160/Naheulbeuks_Dungeon_Master/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/a74ce773c9fce7f5a1820d894940d39f99b95dc6.png

 Fixed a crash occurring at the end of the campaign.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/04a2612edd2760407d55bff2b229955e590436a7.png

 Several save corruption bugs fixed.
 Fixed an issue where destroying or selling a counter in the treasury while a banker was working on it could block the game.
 When the bathroom was modified, minions could be frozen.

[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/f9fe4d3e5d8524fe584a80e34bf888b2bbb131dc.png

 Yrfoul’s book was written in English when the game was in Polish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/5895518479643160224fac8ac8527c20707c896a.png
[olist]
 Task priorities have been reworked

 Minions will satisfy their vital needs earlier (sleeping and eating).
 They'll look after their vital needs first, then their secondary needs, then they'll do one-off jobs like summoning a demon (at the player's command), and finally they'll do their daily work. It's worth noting that both going on strike and demanding their wages take precedence over any other need. Life is about having priorities anyway.
 Mass resignations are way less frequent. 

 A small morale bonus will now be applied to all minions in the dungeon when they resign, to limit mass resignations. 
 When a minion is recruited, the filling level of their gauges has been raised.
 Now when a soldier is fighting, his needs are frozen.
 The "Bored" state no longer lowers the morale meter.
 The calculation of distances made by minions when they are searching for a room has been revised.
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/fa670e23adfe07cfb88d790fba8d961a3f81aa94.png
[olist]
 Minions now run to the tavern (when they want have fun) instead of walking. And their needs keep on decreasing.
 Bankers had an erratic behavior when at their counter: they would stand up and sit, which made their needs decreasing. They should now remain sitting at their counter until all employee are paid.

[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/08b97462f8b938a4f09c00f8f9cb3558393992da.png
[olist]
 Campaign characters (Draja, Orolf, etc.) cannot be healed.
 More complex resignation issues need further investigation:

 Rank 6 minions only eat desserts, which should only be eaten by higher ranking minions (8+).
 Dishes-meals are not eaten enough, which prevents human cooks from ranking up as fast as other minions (as the meals are clogging the production line). Desserts being produced by human cooks from rank 6+ only, this limits the amount produced, thus making high ranking minions (whose needs are not met) resign faster.

  In the sandbox options, deactivating the Golbargh's gauge has the opposite effect: he is permanently on rampage mode.

notes.title: [FAQ] Tips & Tricks
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/594394df7f8d360cfe2fe3292dc88e330f2ac518.png

Hello Community,

We know that this may be the first time you have entered the Naheulbeuk universe. You can find all the Tips & Tricks at the end with a little summary of the universe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/1ee82dbb02c599d3d95b6fa9d7ad05c5169dfee5.png
Building

 While the Tavern is being edited, it stops generating revenue. Consider pausing the game during this time to avoid unnecessary losses.
 Pay attention to every object's effects. Some can help you to keep your minions' spirit up.
 Avoid forcing your minions to climb four flights of stairs to reach basic amenities, like toilets...
 Look-out for new raids/new objects sold on the market. Some can be surprisingly useful.

Minions

 Orcs and Elves don't like each other. You could duplicate basic rooms (one kept clean and one worse than a teenage boy's bedroom) to accommodate both.
 Dwarves are annoying. Don't forget to furnish your rooms with dedicated furniture.
 If something goes wrong, try to look for clues in the HR and Accounting screens.
 Minions ranked 6 and higher prefer to eat sweet-meals.

Fight

 Tocs'hens only call for the closest guard-room and every undead on the floor. Place them with care.
 If adventurers are too strong for your guards, try accumulating armament with your workshops (may also require some dwarves).
 Avoid covering half your dungeon floor in traps, elves (and other minions) might trigger them.

Others


 Any connected controller may interact strangely with the game (we're working on it).

How to cancel a duplicate of a room?
If you started building a room and want to restart from scratch, do not validate the room to stay in building mode and just right-click: you'll be able to delete the room entirely.

If you already built a room and want to delete it, click on the room and press the "sell room" button. Note that some rooms cannot be sold at the beginning of the game as they're needed for the tutorial, but you'll be able to sell them later in the campaign.

I found that there are some unkillable enemies, what should I do?
Remove the relic from the pedestal and it should unblock the situation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/db66dc528babdeb167a630c0a0185f2170e98ad8.png
Management of the Tavern

To manage your tavern properly, It's not enough to just put tables on it! Add more counters until there is a balance between the number of customers the number of people in the queue there.

Improve how your employees move around
If you want people to be able to move around in your dungeon, you put in at least two or three staircases because, in fact, if people can't find a way to go somewhere that could be a reason why they're grumbling so there.

Why did my employees resign?
If the resignations of your employees start at the start of each decade, it's probably because you don't have enough bankers and if there are too many people queuing up, they may get bored and leave. You should put many counters as you can and make sure it's the dwarfs who are working on it. Put them in beds, a canteen, a breaking room to make sure that they have a good working condition.

Why did minions not go to the room that I built?
It could be because they're waiting for their salary, which is the minions' priority. But it could also be because the room is: 

 Too clean or too dirty (depending on the minions' origins)
 Too far away (build amenities close to where minions work!)
 Not prestigious enough for their expectations

Also check the food stocks in the kitchens! Minions won't go to eat if there's a shortage of their preferred food.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/0a6b95fdf0938d765afd84c7dfa0e70d3dd3b0dd.png
This is my first time playing a game in the NBK universe, what should I know?
 The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk is a comedic high fantasy parody series created by John Lang. The series began in 2001 as a French-language online audio series following a party of adventurers in a fantasy role-playing game. John Lang wrote and produced the series, as well as performed most of the character voice. Following its success, the story was adapted into a comic series, a set of novels, and a video game with The Dungeon of Naheulbeuk: The Amulet of Chaos.

Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master is a prequel to The Amulet of Chaos and offers a great starting point for newcomers to the series. All you need to know is that the villainous great sorcerer Zangdar has hired you, the Gobelin steward Reivax, to build, manage and defend the titular Dungeon of Naheulbeuk . Set years before the comic books’ storyline, the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk is in bad shape, close to bankruptcy, and falling apart and under the surveillance of the Dungeons Fund. It is now your job to rebuild everything, replenish the account’s balance, restore the reputation, recruit employees, and attract adventurers. 
Source: FAQ Steam

Stay tuned.

Dear Trainee Stewards,

Welcome to the final DEVBLOG – Meet Other VIPs! Aside from Zangdar and Reivax, you need to know who you'll be working with! 😡

Orlof – Dungeon’s Swordmaster & Guard commander 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/38ecc7b261fa744a688e60fbaa85f839e4da201f.jpg
 A guard room is the pinnacle of strategy.’’ – Solegoode, M. (1429) - Dungeon Master for Dummies  Orlof, the Guard Commander, oversees the daily security of the dungeon and protects it from incursions. To ensure the best security in the dungeon, you will need to work with Orlof to recruit and train guards from different origins. 

Draja – Master Spy & Assassin
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/fe991be7e44c6fe61d0cac0f36200ed8f127c49e.png
 We’ll do evil, but we’ll do it good  Draja Drownen, master drow spy and certified assassin! She's been recruited by Zangdar to organise the dungeon’s evil strike force. Be careful, she may show you the few hundred ears she has cut off as proof of assassination. Don't underestimate on her torture skills...

Her missions are to recruit infiltration specialist and organise raids to attack other dungeons and factions, and to set up inspiring raids. Working with her, you will be able to recruit spies and produce Intel in the guard room. 

Intel and Espionage: What’s it for?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/b315127b9fa22fcd068a835c22307d33bc8bd33f.png
  Intel expands the espionage zone, to find raids of higher quality in the lands of Fangh. Robbing the local blood sausage manufacturer will only get you so far. Intel is produced in the guard room by spies with a strategic table and secret cabinets.   
Mel Boots – Tavern Keeper
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/14b3936b14d0f7b1d05d8e817d383edc17e43add.png
An Orc cook may not be the best you can find. But Mel Boots has been a cook, a barber, an adventurer, a surgeon, an executioner, and an embalmer. He can peel and bone like nobody's business. 

He's the dungeon's new tavern keeper, responsible for stock management and negotiating prices for food and drink with local merchants. Interestingly, he can be found everywhere in the game's dialogue for almost every topic, from the hygiene of the dungeon to its reputation. He cares about everything! There's more, you'll have to discover it!

A little anecdote: 

He sometimes stays in the guardroom for a long time... [hr][/hr] One month to go until the start of your contract... I hope you get on with the team. 

There are also other important characters you'll meet later in the game, in the meantime, join our Discord for an unlimited strike!

notes.title: Dev Blog - Reivax
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/bb4b96a2372d13230cdb9246c90d97065c23d656.jpg
Hello everyone. It's Terry again! Community Developer of Dear Villagers.  

Before you begin your work as Reivax, the Dungeon Steward. It's better to know his history and his role in the game. Let's dive in!


5 Fun Facts about Reivax 
[hr][/hr]
1. A graduate of the Bitter Warlock Sidekick Certification, Reivax has recently applied for the job of chief minion for the famous Zangdar, Naheulbeuk’s Dungeon Master. 

2. Coward and cunning by nature, he is venal and much more intelligent than the others. Some say he secretly runs the dungeon, taking advantage of the Zangdar's credulity. But Zangdar keeps a close eye on his actions and never misses an opportunity to remind him who is in charge. 

3. A smooth talker, he has been accused of embezzlement, false invoicing, and other strange misappropriations. He remains loyal to the Zangdar’s business unless threatened, as he does not support physical pain. 

4. Linguist, he speaks goblin, orc, raven code, ogre, and common troll. 

5. Reivax was born in the northern part of the country, in the town of Mlaüke to be exact. He served at various posts for a short time before finding work in the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. 



Reivax and his duties 
[hr][/hr]
The Dungeon has been in a poor state for too long. As Reivax, the servile (or not) Steward, your mission is to restore it to its former glory and make it profitable!  

In the game, you must build up the Dungeon's reputation and make it the most feared and attractive place in the Lands of Fangh. Meanwhile, don't let Zangdar's patience gauge run out! Otherwise, it's game over! 


Human Resources

[table noborder=1 ]
    [tr]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/403375ac845ad09d8c3e00d466cb9ca7cca02a7a.jpg[/th]
        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/bffbfeca35ebfa0ec372f1e3654e01dc0a6ddb86.png
[/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]Your first job, of course, is to manage the dungeon's human resources.  

Hire less useless personnel to work, defend, raid, and serve your boss, Zangdar. As the Steward, you have several missions in the HR section: 

Improve the minions’ working conditions without exceeding the budget! Each employee you hire has a morale gauge, mainly influenced by fun, hygiene, energy, hunger, food type and quality, and ... getting paid. You must make sure to fulfil their needs for them to perform! 

Put the minions to work! Each one has its own job, rank, origin, and expectations. As your minions' expectations are met, the dungeon's reputation increases. Higher-ranking minions earn more money and fail less often, and vice versa. 

Fire your minions if they are bad at their job or if they protest with impossible demands. You can also help them "understand" with a little tour in jail with your torturers... 

Ensure the working conditions of your minions: Improve the sanitary facilities and hire decent domestics to attract a certain class of customers or servants. 


Treasurer

Once you've hired your minions to work in the dungeon, you'll need to manage your budget and most importantly... make money! 

Firstly, the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk is not a charity. As Reivax, you will need to develop the tavern to bring in some income.  

Manage the tavern: This fine establishment will be your main source of income. You must maximize its profits. Serve the right drinks to the right group of customers, separate the henchmen from you wealthiest customers. Do everything you can to gain Tripes Adviser sausages, your tavern’s prestige indicator. 

Produce: Production is the key to prosperity and monopoly, so you need to generate a wide range of resources to flood the market! Tools, weapons, compost, astral energy and more! Stock them to gain advantages and sell them to gain money! 

Kill adventurers: A Dungeon with a better reputation means more adventurers. More adventurers means more gold for the Dungeon when proof of death of the avid adventurers is provided to the Dungeons Fund. 

Accounting: View the tavern's financial report to see its income and expenses. This will help you adjust your strategy and ensure profitability!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/a8a062cb6bfd8f645fcd70fd8b67000eb5f8cda8.png

Interior Design 

In the game, you will also need to work on the interior design and decoration of the Dungeon. This is one of the ways in which you can increase the prestige of the rooms and thus the reputation of the dungeon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/6fd115f1c60b0ae3e34debcf4501f6e043b6d5b9.png

Security of the Dungeon

The Guard Room is vital to the defence of the Dungeon's entrance. Your job is to hire the guards to protect the dungeon from invaders! 

You must build the guard lockers! Each locker automatically recruits one or more guards. They will do their job until the alarm goes off. When it does, they will automatically go into battle. 


Reivax in Real Life!
[hr][/hr]
We have prepared an exclusive voice-over by Xavier Penin for you! Have fun trying your hand at voice acting and share your experiences with us on Discord!


[previewyoutube=4S4Y99F8uqM;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for reading. By the way, who is your favourite character? Zangdar or Reivax?  
See you soon. 
Terry

notes.title: DevBlog - Zangdar
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237405/b09c92cc64616643b628a3cc26fde661f47c2d20.jpg

Hello!

Welcome to the first dev blog from Naheulbeuk's Dungeon Master! I'm Terry, Community Developer for Dear Villagers. You're in the right place for those of you who have never played a game in the Naheulbeuk universe!

Otherwise, for those who already know Zangdar, this dev blog can be a guide to how to serve your 
boss well!

Zangdar and the universe of Naheulbeuk

5 fun facts about Zangdar that you should know:


 Zangdar, real name Zangfil Darlan-Duchateau, was born in Glargh in 1446 to a bourgeois family, but his career prospects seemed bleak. Despite his parents' hopes that he would excel in sorcery, he proved a complete failure at it. He accidentally caused a disastrous incident and inherited a fortune but felt lost and bitter.
 Purchasing the Naheulbeuk Dungeon, Zangdar found his calling as a master and villain. However, his early attempts at dungeon management were chaotic, leading to a falling out with the Dungeon Treasury, leaving a lasting traumatic memory.
 Establishing his dungeon business, specializing in "statuettes and prophecies," Zangdar gained respect in the region by striking a deal with the village mayor. Adventurers flocked to his dungeon, but many met absurd and unfortunate demises.
 Struggling to retain competent staff and lacking a passion for organisation, he's been downgraded to the rank of shabby dungeon owner. In 1488, Reivax arrived and reluctantly re-established ties with the Dungeon Treasury, helping Zangdar financially by opening a tavern in the Dungeon.
 He is very irascible and impatient - this has always caused him problems in the use of magic, which requires patience and concentration. This is why he is very sensitive to all nuisances and gets angry easily.


Zangdar and the patience gauge mechanic 
Well, in the game, your mission is to restore the Dungeon and, of course, make it profitable, reputable & attractive in the lands of Fangh! Work or get fired!

In the story mode, you play as Reivax, working for Zangdar, the Dungeon Master. When his patience gauge is empty, it's game over! Pay attention because it decreases when there are strikes, a raid fails, high-ranked minions resign and when some of his needs are not satisfied (hunger, fatigue, dirtiness, or the need to go to the toilet). On the other hand, his gauge increases when his minions gain prestige, a raid is successful, when the player unlocks a floor and when the same needs are satisfied. 

In Sandbox mode, however, you can override Zangdar's objectives, and silence him and his comments and self-centred requests about how to run the dungeon. No patience meter, no layoffs. 

Zangdar in Real Life!
As you may know, the game is based on the universe of the Dungeon of Naheulbeuk, a comedic high fantasy parody series created by John Lang. The series began in 2001 as a French-language online audio series following a party of adventurers in a fantasy role-playing game. John Lang wrote and produced the series, as well as performed most of the character voice. 

We prepared an exclusive voice acting of John Lang for you! Have fun trying voice acting yourself and share your experience with us on Discord!

[previewyoutube=n2iXqLJRNVc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for reading. Time to get to work. See you soon on Steam (PC & Mac) this summer. 

Be sure to read the HR Guide before you get to work!

See you soon.
